scope: Owned task entry selection and bounded offline execution decisions. Historical excerpts contain only non-sensitive request text; source IDs stay outside the repository.
evidenceRules: No keyword or option-index semantic grading.
Author checks, historical observations, structural integrity and independent model evidence are different evidence classes.
No claim of activation accuracy from historical file reads or these fixtures alone.
Each answer must distinguish actual actions, next steps and unverified completion.
